hooks.command:
p=$(cat); d=$(printf '%s' "$p" | jq -r '.worktree_path // .worktreePath // .path // .cwd // empty' 2>/dev/null); d="${d:-$PWD}"; printf '
=== %s
payload: %s
resolved: %s
' "$(date)" "$p" "$d" >> ~/.claude/worktree-setup.log; if [ -x "$d/setup.sh" ]; then cd "$d" && ./setup.sh; else echo "worktree setup skipped: no setup.sh at $d"; fi
